name: io.github.RayenMlayeh/gsearch
title: gsearch
description: Real Google Search for AI agents: real URLs, AI Overview and People also ask as typed JSON.

environmentVariables.name: GSEARCH_PROXY
environmentVariables.description: Optional proxies in any format (host:port:user:pass, user:pass@host:port, socks5://...), or a file listing them. Unset: your own IP, at most 20 searches an hour.

environmentVariables.name: GSEARCH_DATA_LIMIT_MB
environmentVariables.description: Optional hard limit on proxy data, in MB, counted across restarts.
